title: KAITO — The Feelings I've Watched Over〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I think we covered everything we were hoping to regarding those improv skits we did today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, then let's take everything we just discussed and try applying it to a different prompt!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're all working so hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I still can't believe you're having practice here after spending the day with Shunmeiza... You all must be extra motivated today.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO!
Are you done setting up those devices for the show?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, they're all ready to go now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's excellent news. If you have time, would you mind watching us for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're about to do an improv skit, and we'd like to hear what you think too, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I don't mind...
But have you checked the time? It's getting pretty late.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! He's right! I didn't notice at all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. It just means you were that focused on practicing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... We just figured out what we need to work on, so it would be nice to immediately put what we learned into practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we may want to call it a day since practice tomorrow starts very early.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree.
It would be self-defeating if we let it get in the way of our practices with Shunmeiza.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, we'll stop here for today!
Let's all do our best during practice tomorrow to apply what we learned!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for watching us practice. We'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good luck with practice tomorrow☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bye bye☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They seem to be making the most of their practices with Shunmeiza.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They've apparently also been practicing like this at home.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we only occasionally get to see what they're doing, but they always seem super serious! Which I think is really cool!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's great to see that they're still doing their best even after leaving Phoenix Wonderland☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, their work ethic is admirable.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And they've grown so much since we first met them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You and Miku have known them the longest, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. When they first came to SEKAI, they didn't get along at all and even got into a few arguments...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But they've overcome so much together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, they have☆
They started doing shows together, and they saved the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And they got the whole park to help with the night show! I still really love what they did.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too☆
And we got to be a part of it! That was super fun♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then they started doing lots of different shows outside of Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, they performed at all those venues!
They did have to face a few tough situations along the way...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But nothing's stopped them from moving forward!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. And now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They're all chasing after their dreams together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They found a way to stay on the same path.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which may've caused that new area in SEKAI to appear.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. And it's such a lovely place.
The harbor's full of plushies, and there's a big ship...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Plus, they were so determined to sail to Star Island on that ship!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. All in all, this place suits them perfectly because they're all chasing after their dreams together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I have to think nothing is going to stop them...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, to ensure that they're able to cross that sea and make their dreams a reality...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's keep giving them all the support we can!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
